loop_primitives.evidence_quote: this closed-loop methodology is both practical and effective for automated feature discovery
loop_primitives.note: Prompt generation -> AutoML oracle evaluation -> refinement; parallel agents form beam search.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: The architect net- work ensures the iterative refinement of the initial generic prompt based on feedback obtained by the oracle.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Agent0 at its core consists of two LLMs that are in constant interaction
multi_agent_topology.note: Architect -> Sentinel -> Oracle fixed hand-off; multi-agent deployment replicates this pipeline with shared memory.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: a singular shared point – the network-hosted memory – yielded superior performance
delegation_mechanism.note: Coordination only via shared memory store.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: final prompt is human-understandable and can be verified before any further actions are considered
human_in_loop.note: Also a supervisor UI monitoring prompt-score tuples.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: stored in a joint memory store of prompt-score tuples

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: network-based shared memory is maintained, enabling agents to asyn- chronously contribute to a joint memory
long_term_memory.note: Persistent store of prompt-score tuples reused as few-shot examples across generations.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Memory consolidation ... A generation of (async) Agent0 instances Next generation (improved memory)
state_persistence.note: Shared memory on disk persists across generations; no explicit resume path described.

self_verification.evidence_quote: the oracle, a component which estimates the relevance of the feature when included into an existing downstream model
self_verification.note: AutoML evaluation (RIG) is the harness-run verifier, closest to test_execution.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: multi-agent system operates in an infinite loop, each update to the memory updates the UI component
retry_policy.note: Continuous refinement loop without fixed attempt cap.

rollback.evidence_quote: If a lift is detected (relatively to not having the feature), feature inclusion is considered successful and stored in a joint memory store
rollback.note: No revert mechanism; failed prompts simply stored with low scores.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: multi-agent system operates in an infinite loop
termination_condition.note: No termination condition stated; loop is open-ended. Closest value chosen is uncertain.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Dedicated caching mechanism was put in place to avoid sending unnecessary requests when not required
cost_controls.note: Routing: fast Gemini-Flash for sentinel, o3 for architect.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Agent0 replicates the AutoML source code repository, dispatches requests to text services, executes data conversion pipelines, and evaluates models
execution_isolation.note: Agents dispatched across heterogeneous machines; isolation not specified.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: meticulous attention was paid to preventing inter-agent data leaks by avoiding shared code, weights, or in- termediary files

network_policy.evidence_quote: Agent0’s implementation intentionally restricts network access to a minimum (internal proxy to larger LLMs), thus not conducting implicit searches

replayability.evidence_quote: This user interface enables interactive exploration of the current space of evaluated prompts during the process itself
replayability.note: Records exist but no replay mechanism described.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: The evaluator (oracle) com- ponent, which in this case is an internal AutoML system that takes as input a search-ready data set and outputs scores based on fixed evaluation proce- dure

guardrails.note: No safety filters described; tool restriction is for load, not safety.
